findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_move, report_problem · Private data: validate, share_link · Public sink: validate, share_link, report_problem · Destructive: report_problem.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_move, report_problem · Private data: validate, share_link · Public sink: validate, share_link, report_problem · Destructive: report_problem

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
